title: MedLabs Laboratories — Jordan branches
notes: robots.txt allows all. Branches come from the site's own country->city->branch selector (admin-ajax actions my_action / my_posts_action / my_post_content_action, country term 28 = Jordan); one record per address block, so posts titled "(3 Branches)" yield 3 records sharing name_en. name_en is the branch title as published (e.g. "3rd Circle"); parent carries the chain. city is the site's city grouping. Coordinates only when the Google Maps link embeds them (short goo.gl links kept in extra.map_link). Opening hours are free text as published. Arabic pages are machine-translated client-side by TranslatePress, so no name_ar was taken. Includes the Referral Lab and Head Office entries. home_visit_service_chain: the site menu offers House Calls Services chain-wide; per-branch availability not stated.
